description: Keysight N9342C handheld spectrum analyzer, 9 kHz – 7 GHz
provenance: Manufacturer datasheet figures, not read out of the manual set — no N9342C guide was swept, so this model's 28 commands were authored by hand. Frequency coverage is the number this sheet exists for and is solid; RBW/VBW/attenuation/sweep bounds are the ones to check against the data sheet before a widget is clamped to them.
